conviction_note: Full-year print at 12:00 JST. The FY2026 beat over the company's plan is already in the IFIS consensus (ordinary 40.8bn against a 35.7bn plan), so what this release adds is the FY2027 first guide and the dividend top-up. This issuer has opened both of the last two years well below the street (FY26 ordinary guided -1.3%, 8.2% under IFIS) and fell -3.3% and -5.5% over two sessions on those full-year prints. A mechanical 40%-payout dividend increase is the offsetting positive. I lean mildly negative (p_up 44) on a scale raised above the 1.99 proxy to 3.5, because the measured median 2-day reaction on the actual release dates is 3.4%. The scaled -0.42 and the findings sum of -0.5 agree in sign and size.
bar: IFIS consensus for FY2026/8 as of 2026-10-08: sales 1,039.5bn, OP 39,167m, ordinary 40,833m, net 21,333m (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=3048), against the company plan of 1,022bn / 34,400 / 35,700 / 18,400, unchanged since 2026-04-10 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592468.pdf). No FY2027 consensus could be sourced, so the guide finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per the baseline). The 信用倍率 is 1.20 per the baseline and the kabutan quote page on 2026-10-09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3048), which is balanced, not a crowded margin long. There is no option skew in Japan. The 20-day run-up is -3.24% and the 5-day +0.73%. The IFIS rating consensus is 3 (neutral) and the consensus target is 1,833 yen. The 5.5x-kind squeeze fuel that would argue against a negative is absent.

findings.finding: FY2027 first guide: the company's documented habit is to open the year far below the street. The FY2025 initial OP guide was 26.5bn, later raised to 31.0bn and finishing at 30.3bn. The FY2026 initial guide was OP 30.5bn and ordinary 31.5bn (-1.3% YoY, 8.2% below IFIS), and the consensus now sits at 39.2bn OP. The FY2027 headwinds are visible in the September 月次 (air-con '大幅に前年を下回った' on the reversal of last year's subsidy-driven demand, PCs and smartphones weak, 情報通信 -9.5%). A flat or low-growth first guide below whatever the street holds for FY27 is the likely shape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Full-year prints on actual release dates: 2024-10-10 -3.29% (prev close to next close), 2025-10-10 -5.49% (FY26 ordinary guided 8.2% under IFIS, with a +1 yen dividend top-up announced the same day). The 2026-04-10 upward revision that landed 2% above consensus still went -4.03%. Computed from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3048.T?range=3y&interval=1d.
findings.why_not_priced: The FY27 guide does not exist until 12:00 today. The FY26 consensus kept rising into the print (39.0bn to 40.8bn ordinary in late September), which is a street extrapolating, not one discounting a low opener. The stock sits 10% under the 1,833 consensus target and has drifted only -3.2% in 20 days. Had the market priced a repeat of last year's 8% guide shortfall, the September consensus upgrades would have been met by a falling price rather than a flat one. Caveat: the habit is public after two repeats, so part of it is held, and that is why this is sized at a third of last year's move.
findings.independence: The FY2025 initial guide comes from a different document, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250411/140120250408510579.pdf (前回予想 OP 26,500 against an FY24 actual of 24,388). The headwinds come from https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s100941.html, which also underlies the positive September finding below, so it is shared there.

findings.finding: Dividend top-up at the print: the policy is a 40% consolidated payout, and the company topped up the year-end dividend at the last full-year print (22 to 23 yen). On the IFIS net consensus of 21.3bn (EPS about 124.6 on 171.25m shares), 40% implies about 50 yen annual, against the 43 yen (20 + 23) still on file. That means a year-end of roughly 30 yen and an FY27 dividend guide likely near 48-50 yen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-10: a +1 yen year-end increase was announced with the results and the stock fell 5.49% over two sessions. 2026-04-10: +2 yen with the H1 upward revision, -4.03%. On this name, capital return has not overridden the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The 43 yen forecast is the number on every quote screen (kabuyoho shows a 2.64% forecast yield on 43 yen), so a jump to about 50 yen is a visible headline for a retail-heavy, 株主優待-holding register. Anyone who applies the 40% policy can derive it, which is why it is sized small.
findings.independence: The policy is restated in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260410/140120260409501232.pdf (2026-04-10, '連結配当性向 40％を目指しております'). The net consensus is from https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=3048.

findings.finding: September 2026, the first month of FY2027: Bic's all-store sales rose 2.7% and Bic+Kojima 2.0%. Peers reported Yamada denki segment -3.0%, K's group -2.1% and Joshin -17.2% for the same month, so Bic is outperforming in the PC-replacement hangover month. Inbound-tilted categories carried it (その他 +18.6%: watches, medicines, liquor).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history of the stock's reaction to a monthly release. The 2026-07-14 print, made with June 月次 at -3.0%, moved +0.18% over two sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: It went out around 10:00 JST on the print day, at the seal, so the 10:05 spot holds at most a few minutes of it. It matters mainly as a tone-setter for how the FY27 guide and the first-half plan are read. Peer comparisons were published 2026-10-06 (Yamada https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s100643.html, K's https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s100641.html).
findings.independence: The peer figures come from separate ryutsuu articles (s100643, s100641, s100649). The Bic figure shares its document with the headwind evidence in the guide finding.

findings.finding: Q4 FY2026 (Jun-Aug) group sales were roughly flat: Bic+Kojima -7.5% in June, +7.8% in July and +1.0% in August (Bic alone -3.0 / +8.5 / +2.2). The IFIS consensus needs Q4 OP of about 5.9bn against 5.76bn a year ago (+2%) and ordinary of about 6.7bn against 6.36bn (+5%). So the FY26 actual against consensus turns on Q4 margin holding without sales leverage, after Q3 OP rose 52% on +10.6% sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-10: an FY25 ordinary profit 5.1% under IFIS was part of the -5.49% reaction. 2026-07-14: a Q3 far ahead of plan moved +0.18%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the 月次 are public and analysts set the 40.8bn consensus after the August figure. What remains is the margin, which the monthly series does not show. Sized near zero for that reason.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Baseline reaction history (median 1.99%) used as the scale
rejected_candidates.detail: The estimated dates are off by up to six days (e.g. Q1 releases were 2025-01-14 and 2026-01-14, not 01-06 and 01-08). The actual 12:00 release dates on kabutan give a median 2-session reaction of 3.4%, and that is used for abs_move_pct.

baseline_tension: The lean is mildly negative while the baseline's priced lean is +0.12 (run-up driven), so it cuts slightly against the baseline. The strongest positive the release could carry is a dividend top-up to about 50 yen plus a mid-term plan upgrade (the FY29 OP 40bn target is nearly met in FY26). I looked for both, and for a buyback history, which is absent. The top-up is filed as a positive. The plan upgrade is unsourced and not filed.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public monthly series): the Q4 月次 finding went from -0.3 to -0.1, and p_up moved from 42 to 44, so expected_move went from -0.56 to -0.42.

Rule 2 (check the sign): the strongest positive (dividend top-up, possible mid-term plan upgrade, buyback) was searched for and written into baseline_tension. The top-up is already filed at +0.4, so nothing else changed.
The FY27 guide finding was left at -1.0, because it is what the release ADDS rather than a visible miss.
